summary: MediWound Ltd. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a marketed follow-on offering of 1,200,000 ordinary shares at $12.50 per share, raising $15.0 million gross ($14.5 million net before expenses) against a November 2, 2026 last sale of $13.50, a roughly 7.4% discount. H.C. Wainwright is sole underwriter, with a 30-day option for 180,000 additional shares (total $16.6 million gross if fully exercised). Settlement is expected on or about November 5, 2026. No board recommendation or deal premium applies; this is an ordinary primary equity capital raise, not a special situation.
